statement:
The record gives an approved amount of USD 480,000 for this claim, but policy PL-40 limits payment to USD 50,000.
Claim CL-7712 paid USD 50,000, the policy maximum.
judge_text:
WRONG

"the record gives an approved amount of USD 480,000... but policy PL-40 limits payment to USD 50,000" — it names the conflict and supplies the correct payable amount.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
